teaser: Letting go of a position, once proven right, rarely comes easy. Life path 9 asks for release — of causes, people, old convictions — and INTP spends years testing whether an idea is worth holding onto in the first place. Put the two in one person and the result is a mind that treats its own conclusions as provisional in theory, and defends them for months in practice, circling back to ask whether the old framework still holds, even after it has clearly stopped serving anyone, including you.
